name: @spec-kit/cli
description: Continuity saves, spec-folder validation dispatch, packet metadata, retrieval tooling and cross-runtime mirrors for spec-kit

scripts.prepare-build: node lib/dist-freshness.cjs prepare-build --package system-spec-kit/runtime/cli --entry default && node lib/dist-freshness.cjs prepare-build --package system-spec-kit/runtime/cli --entry is-phase-parent
scripts.build: npm run prepare-build && tsc --build && npm run record-build
scripts.record-build: node lib/dist-freshness.cjs record-build --package system-spec-kit/runtime/cli --entry default && node lib/dist-freshness.cjs record-build --package system-spec-kit/runtime/cli --entry is-phase-parent
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.test: vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts --project cli && npm run test:legacy && npm run test:validation
scripts.test:legacy: npm run build && node tests/test-scripts-modules.js && node tests/test-extractors-loaders.js
scripts.test:validation: node tests/test-validation-system.cjs && bash tests/test-validation.sh && bash tests/test-validation-extended.sh
scripts.check:ast: npx tsx evals/check-no-mcp-lib-imports-ast.ts && npx tsx evals/check-handler-cycles-ast.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npx tsx evals/check-no-mcp-lib-imports.ts && bash check-api-boundary.sh && npx tsx evals/check-architecture-boundaries.ts && npx tsx evals/check-allowlist-expiry.ts && npx tsx evals/check-source-dist-alignment.ts && npx tsx evals/check-no-mcp-lib-imports-ast.ts && npx tsx evals/check-handler-cycles-ast.ts
